findings.issue: SVG zone enclosures are labelled with `z.title ?? z.id`, but the model schema's zone has `label` (required) and no `title` (schema/archmap-model.schema.json zone: id, kind, label, parent, outside). Every zone enclosure therefore shows its raw id (e.g. zb-web) instead of its label (e.g. 'Web client ...'), unlike the Mermaid and PlantUML exporters which use z.label. tests/export.test.mjs:811 sets `m.zones[0].title`, so x30 mirrors the wrong field and never exercises the real label text.
findings.resolution: Use `z.label ?? z.id` in toSvgGraph (line 929), and change x30 to set `m.zones[0].label` and assert the escaped text appears; add an assertion in x28 that each drawn zone's label text is present.

findings.issue: contradicts task clause 'All model text escaped for PlantUML so it cannot break or inject': toPlantUmlER emits the field name unquoted as the first token of a line (`  ${pesc(f.name)} : type`), and PUML_UNSAFE (line 313) does not escape '@' or '!'. A field named `@enduml` ends the diagram, and one named `!include /etc/passwd` or `!includeurl http://...` becomes a preprocessor directive when someone renders the .puml (file read / network fetch). PlantUML trims leading whitespace before recognising bookends and directives (from my knowledge of its parser; not run here). The file header (lines 47-49) claims 'no model text can start a line, a directive or a macro'. x18 (tests/export.test.mjs ~line 474) only tries `we ird"; name\n@enduml`, where the newline turns into a literal \n, so a name that BEGINS with @ or ! is untested; its own `t.startsWith('!')` / '@' line checks would catch it if fed.
findings.resolution: Add '@' and '!' to PUML_UNSAFE (so they become <U+0040> / <U+0021>), or emit the field name quoted. Extend x18 with `ent.fields[1].name = '@enduml'` and `'!include /etc/passwd'` (as the entire name) so the existing per-line assertions cover it.

findings.issue: contradicts task clause 'an edges table (from, to, type, label, confidence)': the Label column is filled from `e.desc` (the long description), and the edge's `label` field, which the Mermaid and PlantUML exporters label edges with, is never read. Edges that carry a short label (18 of 51 in the golden model, e.g. 'carrier page') show a sentence instead, and x20 (tests/export.test.mjs:601) asserts `e.desc`, so it locks the divergence in.
findings.resolution: Fill the Label column from `e.label` (falling back to empty), optionally add a separate Description column for `desc`; update x20 to match.
